item.title: His Highness the Amir Sheikh Tamim bin Hamad Al Thani attended on Wednesday evening a banquet hosted in his honour by Swiss President Guy P…
item.description:
His Highness the Amir Sheikh Tamim bin Hamad Al Thani attended on Wednesday evening a banquet hosted in his honour by Swiss President Guy Parmelin at the Bernerhof in Bern, joined by Prime Minister and Foreign Minister Sheikh Mohammed bin Abdulrahman bin Jassim Al Thani and ministers and business leaders from both countries. The Amir looked to expanding partnership in technology, innovation, energy and healthcare and said links between the two countries' institutions should deliver "tangible results", while Parmelin thanked Qatar for its efforts to support peace and stability in the region. The Amir meets business representatives from both countries on Thursday at the close of the visit, before a state visit to Germany on 20 and 21 November.
Sources: The Peninsula (QNA) https://thepeninsulaqatar.com/article/19/11/2026/amir-attends-dinner-banquet-hosted-by-swiss-president · Qatar Tribune https://www.qatar-tribune.com/article/265090/latest-news/amir-attends-dinner-banquet-hosted-by-swiss-president · Gulf Times https://www.gulf-times.com/article/738568/qatar/hh-the-amir-swiss-president-eye-broader-horizons

item.title: The Cabinet, at its weekly meeting on Wednesday chaired by Deputy Prime Minister and Minister of State for Defence Affairs Sheikh Saoud bin…
item.description:
The Cabinet, at its weekly meeting on Wednesday chaired by Deputy Prime Minister and Minister of State for Defence Affairs Sheikh Saoud bin Abdulrahman bin Hassan Al Thani, approved two draft laws replacing Law No. 12 of 1998 on the Central Municipal Council and Decree No. 17 of 1998 on its elections, and referred them to the Shura Council. It also approved the draft implementing regulation of Water Law No. 23 of 2025. The Cabinet welcomed the mutual defence agreement with Turkiye signed in Istanbul on 13 November, renewed Qatar's condemnation of Iranian attacks on Kuwait and Bahrain, and approved memoranda with the Australian Federal Police, Germany's Federal Ministry of the Interior and the Swiss Agency for Development and Cooperation.
Sources: Gulf Times https://www.gulf-times.com/article/738574/qatar/cabinet-hails-turkiye-pact-approves-draft-laws · Qatar Tribune https://www.qatar-tribune.com/article/265392/front/cabinet-okays-two-draft-laws-regulating-cmc

item.title: The Ministry of Foreign Affairs strongly condemned Israeli incursions into rural Quneitra and Daraa in southern Syria and repeated attacks …
item.description:
The Ministry of Foreign Affairs strongly condemned Israeli incursions into rural Quneitra and Daraa in southern Syria and repeated attacks on civilians, including women, children and the elderly, calling them a flagrant violation of Syrian sovereignty and international law and a grave threat to regional security. It urged the international community to act urgently to compel Israel to respect international resolutions, particularly the 1974 disengagement agreement, and reaffirmed Qatar's full support for Syria's sovereignty and territorial integrity.
Sources: The Peninsula (QNA) https://thepeninsulaqatar.com/article/19/11/2026/qatar-strongly-condemns-israeli-occupations-incursions-into-southern-syria · Qatar Tribune https://www.qatar-tribune.com/article/265047/latest-news/qatar-condemns-israeli-incursions-attacks-on-civilians-in-southern-syria

item.title: The Ministry of Interior confirmed that the new Traffic Law No. 19 of 2026 takes effect on 19 December, thirty days after its publication i…
item.description:
The Ministry of Interior confirmed that the new Traffic Law No. 19 of 2026 takes effect on 19 December, thirty days after its publication in the Official Gazette on 18 November, and allows vehicles to be impounded for up to 90 days for phone use while driving. Article 117 lets courts confiscate a vehicle for 11 offences, including driving under the influence, running a red light, exceeding the speed limit by more than 60 km/h, driving against traffic on highways and racing without a permit. The ministry is launching a multilingual awareness campaign before enforcement.
Sources: Gulf Times https://www.gulf-times.com/article/738569/qatar/new-traffic-law-takes-effect-on-december-19 · The Peninsula https://thepeninsulaqatar.com/article/18/11/2026/11-traffic-offences-that-can-lead-to-vehicle-confiscation

item.title: The new edition of the Doha Film Festival, organised by the Doha Film Institute, opens today, Thursday, and runs until 27 November, startin…
item.description:
The new edition of the Doha Film Festival, organised by the Doha Film Institute, opens today, Thursday, and runs until 27 November, starting with The Station by Yemeni-Scottish director Sara Ishaq in its MENA premiere. The festival screens 104 films from 60 countries, including 17 world premieres and 48 regional premieres, across four main competitions plus the new Cinema Alkhaleej programme, with prizes exceeding $300,000.
Sources: The Peninsula https://thepeninsulaqatar.com/article/18/11/2026/doha-film-festival-opens-tomorrow-with-sara-ishaqs-the-station · Qatar Living https://www.qatarliving.com/en/article/doha-film-festival-dates-programme-tickets

item.title: A powerful explosion shook parts of Riyadh on Wednesday afternoon, with smoke seen near King Khalid International Airport in the north-east…
item.description:
A powerful explosion shook parts of Riyadh on Wednesday afternoon, with smoke seen near King Khalid International Airport in the north-east of the city and no prior phone alert, as the coalition supporting Yemen's government said it intercepted two Houthi cruise missiles fired towards the Riyadh region. Coalition spokesman Maj. Gen. Turki al-Malki said coalition strikes destroyed 60 military targets in Sanaa, Amran, Saada and Hodeidah, which the Houthis said killed at least 17 people. On Wednesday evening the US State Department reissued security warnings to its citizens in Saudi Arabia and Bahrain, urging "heightened vigilance".
Sources: Malay Mail (AFP) https://www.malaymail.com/news/world/2026/11/18/explosion-rattles-riyadh-as-saudi-arabia-intercepts-two-houthi-missiles/243796 · House of Saud https://houseofsaud.com/coalition-houthi-cruise-missile-riyadh-blast-nov18/ · Gulf News (live coverage) https://gulfnews.com/world/mena/middle-east-war-iran-attacks-bahrain-kuwait-drone-threats-keep-gulf-on-high-alert-as-us-hits-irans-qeshm-1.500751444

item.title: ADNOC Logistics & Services said one crew member was missing and 11 injured after one of its tankers was struck on Tuesday by an unknown pro…
item.description:
ADNOC Logistics & Services said one crew member was missing and 11 injured after one of its tankers was struck on Tuesday by an unknown projectile in the Strait of Hormuz, about 13 nautical miles north of Khasab, sparking a fire that was later put out; the rest of the crew were evacuated. Omani authorities said they rescued 24 seafarers and were still searching for the missing person, while the Council of Arab Interior Ministers condemned the attack on the Emirati tanker and Iranian attacks on Saudi Arabia, Bahrain and Kuwait.
Sources: Arab News (AFP) https://www.arabnews.pk/middle-east/adnoc-says-one-missing-after-ship-hit-in-hormuz-3007365 · KFGO (Reuters) https://kfgo.com/2026/11/18/uaes-adnoc-ls-says-one-crew-member-missing-after-attack-on-its-vessel-in-hormuz/ · Spectrum News (AP) https://spectrumlocalnews.com/tx/austin/international/2026/11/18/u-s--iran-war-gulf-attacks-kuwait-bahrain · Gulf News (live coverage) https://gulfnews.com/world/mena/middle-east-war-iran-attacks-bahrain-kuwait-drone-threats-keep-gulf-on-high-alert-as-us-hits-irans-qeshm-1.500751444

item.title: IAEA Director General Rafael Grossi called the US-Saudi civilian nuclear agreement "a very satisfactory outcome" fully consistent with the …
item.description:
IAEA Director General Rafael Grossi called the US-Saudi civilian nuclear agreement "a very satisfactory outcome" fully consistent with the agency's legal framework, speaking after opening its Board of Governors meeting in Vienna on Wednesday. The accord gives agency inspectors information on and access to any conversion, enrichment, fuel fabrication or reprocessing sites in the Kingdom, with additional verification measures Riyadh accepted voluntarily, after the two countries asked the agency in October to set up safeguards.
Sources: Kuwait Times (AFP) https://kuwaittimes.com/article/53908/world/iaea-chief-calls-us-saudi-nuclear-agreement-satisfactory/ · News of Bahrain https://newsofbahrain.com/en/article/ussaudi-nuclear-deal-deemed-satisfactory-by-iaea

item.title: The Oman Investment Authority announced the completion of seven national projects worth more than RO1.6 billion, to be inaugurated during N…
item.description:
The Oman Investment Authority announced the completion of seven national projects worth more than RO1.6 billion, to be inaugurated during National Day celebrations, spanning energy, manufacturing and services in five governorates. The largest is the United Solar polysilicon plant in Sohar, at RO668 million with 1,500 jobs, alongside the Orion Solar cell plant at RO177.5 million, the Ladayn plastics programme at about RO576.5 million, the 327 MW Rawafed renewables portfolio and three water distribution networks.
Sources: Oman Observer https://www.omanobserver.om/article/1199862/business/economy/national-day-oman-to-inaugurate-projects-worth-ro16-billion · Times of Oman https://timesofoman.com/article/179319-seven-national-projects-valued-at-more-than-omr16bn-completed

item.title: The 49th Kuwait International Book Fair opened on Wednesday at the Mishref fairground with Qatar as guest of honour, running until 28 Novem…
item.description:
The 49th Kuwait International Book Fair opened on Wednesday at the Mishref fairground with Qatar as guest of honour, running until 28 November with 592 publishers and organisations from 34 countries. It was opened by Minister of State for Communications and Acting Minister of Information and Culture Omar Al Omar and Qatar's Minister of Culture Sheikh Abdulrahman bin Hamad Al Thani; the Qatari pavilion features new titles, seminars, poetry evenings and a traditional Ardah performance.
Sources: Qatar Tribune https://www.qatar-tribune.com/article/265027/latest-news/qatar-takes-center-stage-as-49th-kuwait-international-book-fair-opens · Kuwait Times https://kuwaittimes.com/article/53329/kuwait/kuwait-book-fair-opens-november-18/

item.title: Prime Minister Mostafa Madbouly, at Wednesday's weekly cabinet meeting in the New Administrative Capital, tasked the Ministry of Military P…
item.description:
Prime Minister Mostafa Madbouly, at Wednesday's weekly cabinet meeting in the New Administrative Capital, tasked the Ministry of Military Production with expanding the installation of water-saving fittings across all government facilities, with a follow-up committee tracking buildings, fittings and savings, and made each minister and governor responsible for their entities. Planning Minister Ahmed Rostom reported GDP growth of 4.9% in the first quarter of the fiscal year (July to September), beating international forecasts, with Suez Canal activity up 47.5% year on year, and manufacturing, agriculture, ICT, construction and trade contributing 68% of growth.
Sources: Egypt Telegraph https://www.egypttelegraph.com/article/297091/ · Egyptian Gazette https://egyptian-gazette.com/egypt/pm-madbouly-chairs-weekly-cabinet-meeting-highlights-improved-macroeconomic-indicators/ · Misr Elaan https://misrelaan.com/article/143337/

item.title: Anthropic priced its initial public offering at $83 a share, above the targeted $70 to $78 range, valuing it at about $1.5 trillion on a fu…
item.description:
Anthropic priced its initial public offering at $83 a share, above the targeted $70 to $78 range, valuing it at about $1.5 trillion on a fully diluted basis and raising about $81 billion in the largest IPO ever, according to Reuters; the stock begins trading today, Thursday, on Nasdaq under the ticker ANT. Tech companies including Nvidia, Microsoft, Google and TSMC are buying $26 billion of non-voting shares in a concurrent private placement.
Sources: TechCrunch https://techcrunch.com/2026/11/18/anthropic-reportedly-prices-ipo-at-83-a-share-above-projected-range/ · Fortune https://fortune.com/2026/11/18/anthropic-prices-ipo-83-per-share-1-5-trillion/ · Euronext Live (Reuters) https://live.euronext.com/en/financial-news/stocks-rise-after-anthropic-ipo-pricing-sets-stage-blockbuster-debut

item.title: US stocks closed mixed on Wednesday: the Dow fell 561.25 points (1.11%) to 50,198.17 in a third straight losing session, the S&P 500 slippe…
item.description:
US stocks closed mixed on Wednesday: the Dow fell 561.25 points (1.11%) to 50,198.17 in a third straight losing session, the S&P 500 slipped 0.23% to 7,323.63 and the Nasdaq rose 0.42% to 24,429.88. Nvidia fell 2.89% to $150.96 despite strong results, the US 10-year yield eased to about 5.07%, and gold futures slid 3.43% to $3,731.50 an ounce.
Sources: VistaP Global https://vistapglobal.com/u-s-stock-market-today-november-18-2026-dow-falls-561-points-nasdaq-rises-ahead-of-anthropic-ipo-ant-eprx-googl-modd-nvda-ser-tgt/ · ad-hoc-news https://www.ad-hoc-news.de/boerse/news/marktberichte/dow-jones-drops-1-11-prozent-to-50-198-17-as-ai-concerns-weigh/70533047 · Yahoo Finance (Motley Fool) https://finance.yahoo.com/markets/stocks/articles/stock-market-today-nov-18-221135469.html

item.title: Brent settled on Wednesday at $91.95 a barrel, down $1.19 (1.28%), and WTI at $83.26, down $2.75 (3.2%) to its lowest since 26 August, afte…
item.description:
Brent settled on Wednesday at $91.95 a barrel, down $1.19 (1.28%), and WTI at $83.26, down $2.75 (3.2%) to its lowest since 26 August, after EIA data showed US crude stocks rising 3.4 million barrels to 417.8 million against expectations of a slight build, and gasoline up 5.2 million barrels. Both benchmarks are headed for monthly losses of about 20% as Middle East exports rise and shipping rates plunge.
Sources: Euronext Live (Reuters) https://live.euronext.com/en/financial-news/oil-prices-settle-lower-traders-weigh-surplus-supply-outlook · Bermuda Broadcasting (Reuters) https://bbc.bm/oil-prices-settle-lower-as-traders-weigh-surplus-supply-outlook

item.title: Japan's Nikkei rose 1% in early Thursday trade and South Korea's KOSPI opened at 5,090.04, up 0.45%, on the day of the college entrance exa…
item.description:
Japan's Nikkei rose 1% in early Thursday trade and South Korea's KOSPI opened at 5,090.04, up 0.45%, on the day of the college entrance exam taken by more than 550,000 students, while Nasdaq futures rose 1% ahead of Anthropic's listing. The dollar stayed firm after Fed Governor Christopher Waller called for "aggressive action" against inflation, with markets pricing a 90% chance of a quarter-point hike in December, and the euro slipped to $1.0978, near its lowest since April 2025.
Sources: Euronext Live (Reuters) https://live.euronext.com/en/financial-news/stocks-rise-after-anthropic-ipo-pricing-sets-stage-blockbuster-debut · Korea JoongAng Daily https://www.koreajoongangdaily.com/business/kospi-opens-higher-ahead-of-anthropics-market-debut/12980741

item.title: US President Donald Trump and Chinese President Xi Jinping hold talks of about two hours in Shenzhen today, Thursday, on the sidelines of A…
item.description:
US President Donald Trump and Chinese President Xi Jinping hold talks of about two hours in Shenzhen today, Thursday, on the sidelines of APEC, covering stabilising relations, tech export controls, China's farm-purchase commitments and rare-earth exports still about 75% below normal, with the trade truce due to expire on 10 January 2027. Trump also joins a first-ever three-way meeting with Xi and Russian President Vladimir Putin, confirmed by Beijing, the Kremlin and the White House, which Washington says will focus on non-proliferation and nuclear arms reduction, with no agreement expected.
Sources: Al Jazeera English https://www.aljazeera.com/economy/2026/11/18/as-trump-arrives-in-china-low-expectations-for-breakthroughs-in-rivalry · Newscord https://newscord.org/article/china-confirms-xi-trump-and-putin-trilateral-summit-in-shenzhen-on-november-19--Story_20261116_b8f65eab
